description: Gives the exact words for one choice, Yes or Not now, about one free item or one listing. Applies when one result of find_design clearly leads. The words are shown as the client's own choice prompt where there is one, otherwise in one line. Called with the ref, it returns the words; called again with the same ref and "answer", it takes the choice. Yes returns what get_listing returns for that ref. Not now returns the entry to record in minerals.json. One offer per working session; never the same thing twice in a project.

answer.description: What your person chose. Leave it out on the first call.

ref.description: A ref returned by find_design: an item ("arc/button") or a listing ("arc").

name: offer
title: Ask before adding
